subject: Array row and column selection bug?

messages.author: 78c4b7b5f6907d81
messages.subject: Array row and column selection bug?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am wondering if I found a bug, or just made a mistake.

I cannot manage to compile this simplified c++ code:
#include <TMB.hpp>
template<class Type>
Type objective_function<Type>::operator() ()
{
  PARAMETER_ARRAY(mu);
  mu.row(0);
  return 1;
}

However, the following compiles without error:
#include <TMB.hpp>
template<class Type>
Type objective_function<Type>::operator() ()
{
  PARAMETER_ARRAY(mu);
  mu.col(0);
  return 1;
}

From https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/blob/master/TMB/inst/template.cpp:
We declare array<Type> a(n1,n2,n3).
Since a.col(i) is the R equivalent of a[,,i], then a.row(i) should be the R equivalent of a[i,,].
Is the row function not implemented for arrays, or am I using it incorrectly?

Many thanks :)

messages.author: 02e03030784aa6a7
messages.subject: Re: Array row and column selection bug?
parts:
According to: http://kaskr.github.io/adcomp/structtmbutils_1_1array.html
arrays do not have row() function. 
Hans
